newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list Goldman Sachs technology indices.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list Goldman Sachs technology indices.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange said on Tuesday it would list options on seven technology-related indices on September 27.

The CBOE said the seven indices, developed by U.S. investment bank Goldman Sachs, are the Goldman Sachs Technology Indexes (GSTI) Composite, the GSTI Hardware, the GSTI Internet, the GSTI Multimedia Networking, the GSTI Semiconductor, the GSTI Services, and the GSTI Software.
The GSTI options will be European-style, based on $100 times the underlying index level and cash-settled, the CBOE said.
The GSTI composite index, a capitalization-weighted index, consists of 178 stocks and has a total market capitalization of about $809.5 billion.
On April 30 it was scaled to equal 100 and at 1130 CDT (1630 GMT) Tuesday it was at 107.25, up 0.96.
The six GSTI sub-indices consist of seven or more stocks from the composite index and are modified capitalization weighted. The indices are re-balanced semi-annually.
